findings.message: The identification header shares its page with other packets, where the Vorbis I specification puts it on a page of its own (section A.2).
The comment header's framing bit is 0; libvorbis 1.3.7 refuses the header.
The comment header holds 2 bytes after its framing bit, which readers ignore.
